rows.note: Local sales taxes. No local sales or use taxes in Kentucky.

rows.label: Groceries (food for home consumption)
rows.note: Exempt: food and food ingredients as defined in KRS 139.485; prepared food is taxable.

rows.label: Use tax rate
rows.note: Taxable purchases on which no sales tax was paid (storage, use or consumption in the state). Use tax at 6% of the purchase price of tangible personal property and digital property stored, used or consumed in Kentucky.

rows.label: Remote sellers: sales threshold
rows.note: Remote retailer's gross receipts from sales into Kentucky, previous or current calendar year: must register and collect at $100,000 or more.

rows.label: Remote sellers: transactions threshold
rows.note: Remote retailer's sales into Kentucky, previous or current calendar year (a separate test until 31 July 2026). Counted in transactions. House Bill 757 (2026) removed the 200-transaction standard from 1 August 2026; the Department's letter names only that standard as removed.

sections.note: State figures from the state's tax department or statutes; each row has its own source. Local rates by county, city and district are published by the state (not listed here). Categories not listed follow the state's general rule.
